title: A stored XSS in pretix-adyen has been discovered where an attacker could configure his own ticket shop in a way that…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in pretix-adyen where an attacker can configure a ticket shop to redirect API calls to a malicious server. The responses from this server are embedded in the shop without proper escaping, enabling full XSS attacks including potential session hijacking.
